item.title: Reckoning with Multiple Myeloma
item.description:
This is a notebook of me trying to understand the important aspects of multiple myeloma - the basics of cell biology, what turns a healthy cell cancerous, how myeloma is diagnosed, how it is treated, how we know those treatments work through clinical trials, where care is heading, and how treatment differs in the US and India.

Basics of cell biology

Cancer originates from a malfunction in the cell biology. So it is important to understand the basic machinery of the cell first, which I reduce here crudely into its form and function.
